name: MD-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Mfume running with a large cash advantage
Republican challenger has minimal reported fundraising
model.rationale: The fundamentals point overwhelmingly to Mfume: a D+31 district, an incumbent with over $700,000 on hand against a challenger with no reported fundraising, and markets pricing a Democratic win near 96%. No polls or expert ratings contradict this picture.
model.watch: Any unexpected polling showing a competitive race or major outside spending against Mfume would warrant revisiting.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Baltimore-area MD-07 is one of the most Democratic-leaning districts in the country, with a partisan lean of D+31. Kweisi Mfume, a well-established incumbent, is seeking another term and holds a decisive financial edge, with about $700,000 on hand. His Republican challenger, Scott Collier, has reported little to no fundraising, and no outside groups are active in the race.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available, but prediction markets put Mfume's chances around 96%. With the incumbent renominated and no evidence of a serious challenge, the seat is expected to remain comfortably in Democratic hands.
